CFO, Plant Head and QA approval are all required. Under the VOS-7 approval matrix a projected annual spend above Rs 10,00,000 requires CFO approval, and a direct-material vendor requires Plant Head and QA clearance at any value; these conditions compound, so a direct-material vendor at Rs 14,00,000 needs all three.

Nil - no discount applies. PP-2023 superseded PP-2019 in full with effect from 1 October 2023, so a March 2024 order is governed by PP-2023, under which a single order below Rs 5,00,000 attracts no discount (Rs 5,00,000 to Rs 15,00,000 attracts 10% and above Rs 15,00,000 attracts 14%).
A restocking charge of 10% of invoice value applies to unused goods in original packing returned within 30 days of despatch; made-to-order items are not returnable.
